Elevated S&P 500 valuations (P/E near historical highs) may limit forward returns over the medium term
news.verdict: VOO remains a cornerstone holding for mid-to-long-term investors seeking broad U.S. large-cap exposure at minimal cost, but investors should be aware of current valuation stretch and concentration in mega-cap tech names.
